people-ops: Quick org note  please welcome Marina Lopez, joining as Sr. Eng Manager, Model Ops, start date 2026-05-11. She'll lead the new Model Ops squad focused on model versioning, rollouts, and compatibility testing.

Aisha Patel: Welcome Marina!! 🎉 Hiring plan: we'll backfill two IC roles on Model Ops and open one Sr. SWE (platform) to support rollout infra. I'll post req owners later today.

Marina Lopez: Hi all  excited to be here. First week I'll meet the runtime, deploy, and QA leads and review our current canary/rollout playbooks.

Omar Singh: Heads up  as part of this change, we'll move one product manager from Serving Runtime into Model Ops (PM-Run2 -> PM-Model3) to keep product continuity. Ops headcount remains net-neutral.

people-ops: Noted. Omar  please confirm updated org chart and add the role transfers to the HR change form by EOD.

Jules Park: Congrats Marina! For interviews on the Sr. SWE, please include a systems design round focused on model compatibility testing and a short take-home exercise (20-30m).

HiringBot: Reminder: create Greenhouse openings tag: "model-ops" and set referral window to internal-first for 5 business days. Due: 2026-04-08.

Aisha Patel: Internal-first confirmed. We'll run a 1-week referral window before external posting. Interview panel: eng manager, runtime lead, product manager, people-ops.

Marina Lopez: Thanks team. Interview focus: deployment safety (rollbacks, shadowing), model AB testing, and infra for reproducible evals.

people-ops: Onboarding checklist link: https://redwood.company/onboarding/model-ops. Please add team-specific playbooks under "Marina Lopez onboarding" folder.

Omar Singh: I'll post the updated org chart + migration timeline by tomorrow. Target for role transfers: completed by 2026-06-01.

Aisha Patel: Action items: Aisha to post req owners; HiringBot will ping for rubrics; Omar to submit HR form; Marina to share 1:1 schedule. Welcome Marina! :confetti_ball:
